title.zh: 约化 Hall 环向漂移闭合

summary: Project gyrotropic pressure force to toroidal current on an R-Z grid, solve an optional bounded local toroidal-inertia correction, and report ion/electron drifts, generalized-Ohm and scale diagnostics.
aliases: reduced Hall drift and current closure

identity.relation: R-Z field, ion pressure, electrostatic potential and species closure state to reduced Hall toroidal current and drifts
identity.direction: R-Z grid, B_R, B_Z, p_parallel, p_perpendicular, closure_state, plasma_mask and ion properties -> J_phi, toroidal species velocities and diagnostics
identity.definition: Form cylindrical gyrotropic pressure-force components using second-order grid gradients. Project their perpendicular part as J_phi=(B_Z force_R-B_R force_Z)/|B|^2. On active non-axis cells with ion density above the fractional peak-density floor and resolvable |B|, combine E=-grad(phi), electron pressure force and Hall multiplier to obtain the toroidal drift. Optionally iterate the radial centrifugal correction to J_phi with bounded under-relaxation and cap the ion velocity by maximum_inertial_mach times the ion thermal speed. Return masked current, species drifts and residual/scale diagnostics; the Hall multiplier and optional inertia are part of this implemented relation, not an unrestricted two-fluid solution.
identity.model: reduced axisymmetric Hall drift with gyrotropic pressure and optional local toroidal-inertia correction
identity.geometry: rectilinear cylindrical R-Z grid, at least three nodes per axis
identity.coordinates: R nonnegative, R and Z strictly increasing; arrays indexed [Z,R]
identity.boundary: Second-order one-sided gradient stencils at grid ends; the radial pressure force and initial pressure-current projection are set to zero at an included R=0 axis. The inertia iteration recomputes a current candidate without reapplying that axis rule, so returned J_phi is not unconditionally axis-zero. Hall drift is inactive on the axis and outside the selected density, field and plasma mask.
assumptions: B_R and B_Z are poloidal field components in tesla, with no B_phi contribution in this relation.
The pressure arrays and closure_state describe compatible ion/electron populations in SI units.
The density floor, Mach cap and small-denominator branches are implemented numerical controls, not independent evidence that a low-density or low-field plasma model is physically valid.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: Rectilinear, nonnegative increasing radial axis, at least three columns; same shape as z_grid and fields.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Rectilinear increasing axial axis, at least three rows; same shape as r_grid and fields.

inputs.name: b_r
inputs.constraints: Exactly grid-shaped after joint field/pressure broadcasting.

inputs.name: b_z
inputs.constraints: Exactly grid-shaped after joint field/pressure broadcasting.

inputs.name: p_parallel
inputs.description: Ion or total pressure parallel to the local poloidal field used in the force projection.
inputs.constraints: Exactly grid-shaped after joint broadcasting; physical use requires a consistent nonnegative pressure even though this primary array is checked only for finiteness.

inputs.name: p_perpendicular
inputs.description: Pressure perpendicular to the local poloidal field used in the force projection.
inputs.constraints: Exactly grid-shaped after joint broadcasting; physical use requires a consistent nonnegative pressure even though this primary array is checked only for finiteness.

inputs.name: closure_state
inputs.description: Species state with ion_density, electron_pressure and electrostatic_potential; optionally electron_p_parallel, electron_p_perpendicular, ion_p_parallel and ion_p_perpendicular.
inputs.dtype: Python mapping containing finite real array-like values
inputs.constraints: Required keys broadcast to the grid; ion_density and electron pressures nonnegative. Optional electron pressure components default to electron_pressure; optional ion pressure components default to primary p_parallel/p_perpendicular and must be finite and nonnegative.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Cells used for current and Hall-drift support.
inputs.constraints: Exactly grid-shaped; J_phi is zero outside it. Hall drift additionally excludes R=0, low density and unresolved field cells.

inputs.name: hall_multiplier
inputs.description: Multiplier applied in the Hall drift relation.
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative; zero disables its explicit Hall terms but does not by itself suppress the pressure-current projection.

inputs.name: include_toroidal_inertia
inputs.constraints: Actual boolean scalar, not a numeric 0/1 substitute.

inputs.name: hall_density_floor_fraction
inputs.description: Fraction of peak in-mask ion density used as the Hall-active density floor.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= value < 1; active cells require density strictly above this floor.

inputs.name: maximum_inertial_mach
inputs.description: Ion thermal-speed fraction used as the drift-velocity cap.

inputs.name: inertia_relax
inputs.description: Previous-current weight for the local inertia iteration.

inputs.name: inertia_tolerance
inputs.description: Relative current-change stopping threshold for the local iteration.

outputs.name: J_phi
outputs.description: Masked toroidal current-density projection including optional centrifugal correction.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside plasma_mask. The initial pressure-current axis projection is zero, but optional inertia mixing can produce a nonzero returned axis current when input fields are not axis-regular.

outputs.name: force_R
outputs.description: Radial target force after subtracting the computed centrifugal term.
outputs.constraints: Differs from pressure_force_R when inertia contributes.

outputs.name: force_Z
outputs.description: Axial target force; no centrifugal Z term is applied.
outputs.constraints: Equal to pressure_force_Z in this implementation.

outputs.name: pressure_force_R
outputs.description: Uncorrected radial cylindrical pressure force.
outputs.constraints: Computed before the inertia correction.

outputs.name: pressure_force_Z
outputs.description: Uncorrected axial cylindrical pressure force.
outputs.constraints: Computed before the inertia correction.

outputs.name: electron_pressure_force_R
outputs.description: Radial force from optional electron pressure components.
outputs.constraints: Uses electron_pressure for both components when optional components are absent.

outputs.name: electron_pressure_force_Z
outputs.description: Axial force from optional electron pressure components.
outputs.constraints: Uses the same grid stencil as the primary pressure force.

outputs.name: parallel_force
outputs.description: Target force projected along the poloidal field.
outputs.constraints: Uses zero where the field denominator is numerically unresolved.

outputs.name: parallel_force_error
outputs.description: In-mask RMS parallel target force divided by RMS target-force magnitude.
outputs.constraints: Denominator uses the implementation's numeric tiny floor; zero for an empty plasma mask.

outputs.name: momentum_residual_R
outputs.description: Radial residual J_phi B_Z minus target radial force.
outputs.constraints: Diagnostic only.

outputs.name: momentum_residual_Z
outputs.description: Axial residual -J_phi B_R minus target axial force.
outputs.constraints: Diagnostic only.

outputs.name: momentum_error
outputs.description: In-mask RMS momentum-residual magnitude divided by RMS target-force magnitude.
outputs.constraints: Diagnostic only; zero for an empty plasma mask.

outputs.name: ion_toroidal_velocity
outputs.description: Capped ion toroidal drift on Hall-active cells.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside hall_active_mask.

outputs.name: electron_toroidal_velocity
outputs.description: Ion drift minus J_phi/charge-density on Hall-active cells.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside hall_active_mask.

outputs.name: raw_ion_toroidal_velocity
outputs.description: Unclipped ion toroidal velocity expression.
outputs.constraints: Not masked after evaluation; inspect hall_active_mask for physical support.

outputs.name: ion_toroidal_mach
outputs.description: Capped ion velocity divided by modeled ion thermal speed.
outputs.constraints: Zero where thermal speed is zero.

outputs.name: raw_ion_toroidal_mach
outputs.description: Unclipped ion velocity divided by ion thermal speed on active cells.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside the active, nonzero-thermal-speed branch.

outputs.name: centrifugal_force_R
outputs.description: Local ion toroidal centrifugal correction.
outputs.constraints: Zero when inertia is disabled or the cell is inactive.

outputs.name: electric_field_R
outputs.description: Negative radial electrostatic-potential gradient.
outputs.constraints: Second-order grid derivative.

outputs.name: electric_field_Z
outputs.description: Negative axial electrostatic-potential gradient.
outputs.constraints: Second-order grid derivative.

outputs.name: hall_electric_field_R
outputs.description: Reduced Hall radial electric-field contribution.
outputs.constraints: Computed with the safe charge-density denominator, including outside hall_active_mask.

outputs.name: hall_electric_field_Z
outputs.description: Reduced Hall axial electric-field contribution.
outputs.constraints: Computed with the safe charge-density denominator, including outside hall_active_mask.

outputs.name: ohm_residual_R
outputs.description: Radial generalized-Ohm residual on Hall-active cells.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside hall_active_mask.

outputs.name: ohm_residual_Z
outputs.description: Axial generalized-Ohm residual on Hall-active cells.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside hall_active_mask.

outputs.name: ohm_parallel
outputs.description: Generalized-Ohm residual projected along the poloidal field.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside hall_active_mask.

outputs.name: generalized_ohm_error
outputs.description: Active-cell RMS generalized-Ohm residual divided by RMS electric/Hall/drift scale.
outputs.constraints: Diagnostic only; zero for an empty active mask.

outputs.name: firehose_margin
outputs.description: Local 1-mu0*(p_parallel-p_perpendicular)/max(|B|^2,tiny).
outputs.constraints: Diagnostic only; no firehose rejection is performed here.

outputs.name: ion_skin_depth
outputs.description: Ion inertial length from mass, charge and local density.
outputs.constraints: Zero where density is zero.

outputs.name: electron_skin_depth
outputs.description: Ion skin depth times square root of electron-to-ion mass ratio.
outputs.constraints: Uses a fixed electron mass constant.

outputs.name: ion_gyroradius
outputs.description: Ion thermal-speed gyroradius using the poloidal field magnitude.
outputs.constraints: Zero where the magnetic magnitude is zero.

outputs.name: magnetic_scale_length
outputs.description: Field magnitude divided by its R-Z gradient magnitude.
outputs.constraints: Infinity where the gradient magnitude is zero.

outputs.name: hall_scale_ratio
outputs.description: Ion skin depth divided by finite positive magnetic scale length.
outputs.constraints: Zero where the scale length is infinite or nonpositive.

outputs.name: electron_inertia_scale_ratio
outputs.description: Electron skin depth divided by finite positive magnetic scale length.
outputs.constraints: Zero where the scale length is infinite or nonpositive.

outputs.name: ion_gyroradius_scale_ratio
outputs.description: Ion gyroradius divided by finite positive magnetic scale length.
outputs.constraints: Zero where the scale length is infinite or nonpositive.

outputs.name: hall_active_mask
outputs.description: Plasma, non-axis, above-density-floor and resolvable-field intersection.
outputs.constraints: Selects drift evaluation and active-cell Ohm diagnostics.

outputs.name: density_floor_m3
outputs.description: Peak in-mask ion density times hall_density_floor_fraction.
outputs.constraints: Zero when plasma_mask is empty.

outputs.name: velocity_cap_fraction
outputs.description: Fraction of Hall-active cells whose raw Mach magnitude exceeds the cap.
outputs.constraints: Zero when hall_active_mask is empty.

outputs.name: inertia_iterations
outputs.description: Executed local current updates, including one pass when inertia is disabled.
outputs.constraints: Between 1 and inertia_max_iterations for a returned result.

outputs.name: inertia_relative_change
outputs.description: Last local current update's relative norm change.
outputs.constraints: Uses max(norm(next current),1) as denominator.

outputs.name: inertia_converged
outputs.description: Whether local iteration stopped successfully or inertia was bypassed.
outputs.constraints: A false state raises before the mapping is returned.

preconditions: Fields, pressures and species state refer to one consistent axisymmetric R-Z physical state in SI units.
A strictly increasing rectilinear grid has at least three points per axis, with supplied field and pressure arrays matching its shape.
The electron and ion state needed by the selected model is provided at each grid cell.
supported: Reduced-Hall toroidal drift/current and selected local inertia, Ohm, force and scale diagnostics on a supplied discrete poloidal field.
excluded: A complete equilibrium solve, generalized two-fluid transport or evolution of the electron/ion thermodynamic state.
Automatic proof of physical validity in low-density, near-zero-field, firehose-unstable or high-Mach regions.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for invalid mass, charge or scalar controls; a nonboolean inertia flag; malformed R-Z grid; nonfinite/mismatched field or pressure arrays; wrong-shaped mask; absent or nonfinite required closure_state fields; or negative density/electron and optional ion pressure components. Some malformed optional state arrays may propagate NumPy broadcasting errors.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: A local inertia fixed point that exceeds inertia_max_iterations raises RuntimeError. Other NumPy arithmetic and conversion failures propagate; extreme finite inputs are not guaranteed to produce finite diagnostics.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: The local inertia loop is bounded; when enabled and its current-change threshold is not reached, RuntimeError is raised instead of returning a partial state.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No result mapping is returned after an exception. A returned mapping has inertia_converged=true, including the no-inertia branch.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel relation mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 reduced-Hall drift Operator and direct regressions. Historical candidate labels are development provenance, not current SciRel expert recognition.
source_kinds: saved L1 Operator contract and implementation

python.signature: close_reduced_hall_drift(r_grid, z_grid, b_r, b_z, p_parallel, p_perpendicular, closure_state, plasma_mask, ion_mass_kg, ion_charge_c, hall_multiplier=1.0, include_toroidal_inertia=True, hall_density_floor_fraction=0.1, maximum_inertial_mach=0.5, inertia_relax=0.5, inertia_tolerance=1e-10, inertia_max_iterations=80)

example.description: Uniform isotropic pressure and potential in an axial field produce zero toroidal current and species drift.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.closures import close_reduced_hall_drift
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid([0.0, 0.2, 0.4], [-0.2, 0.0, 0.2])
zeros = np.zeros_like(r_grid)
pressure = np.full_like(r_grid, 20.0)
state = {'ion_density': np.full_like(r_grid, 1e18), 'electron_pressure': zeros, 'electrostatic_potential': zeros}
result = close_reduced_hall_drift(r_grid, z_grid, zeros, np.full_like(r_grid, 2.0), pressure, pressure, state, np.ones_like(r_grid, dtype=bool), 1.67262192595e-27, 1.602176634e-19)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['J_phi'], 0.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['ion_toroidal_velocity'], 0.0)
assert result['inertia_converged']
example.expected: The current and ion toroidal velocity vanish and the bounded local inertia calculation reports convergence.

scope: Uniform isotropic zero-current and zero-drift limit.
Manufactured electron-pressure/potential gradients and generalized-Ohm drift.
Axis/vacuum mask handling, source-compatible field hypot extremes and invalid species/control rejection.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel regressions check selected discrete identities, mask behavior, a manufactured drift and input failures; they do not certify a complete two-fluid model, arbitrary equilibrium, general continuum accuracy, convergence for all inertia controls or current expert recognition.
known_limitations: The active mask excludes the axis and selected low-density/near-zero-field cells; inactive diagnostics may still contain computed unmasked values.
The implementation uses the first-principles source-compatible discrete stencil and numerical floors; extreme finite values can still overflow.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.
